A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RPG research work. Their complete main texts, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–L support comparison after matching relocated material.

before.justification: v3 reports original LLM training experiments, mathematical reasoning benchmark scores, training dynamics, and clipping, KL-coefficient, and reference-update ablations.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experimental results in Section 5 and Appendix I, including experiments using Qwen3-4B and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct.

M1.justification: Algorithms 1 and 2 and the underlying KL objectives are unchanged. However, new Eq. (4.1) explicitly detaches only the regularized advantage, whereas Algorithm 2 also detaches importance-weight coefficients. Whether its clipping operator C implicitly preserves that behavior or describes a different gradient procedure is unclear.

E1.justification: Both versions retain DAPO-Math-17k training data and evaluation on AIME24, AIME25, AMC23, Minerva-Math, and OlympiadBench. The 2K, 4K, and 8K scenarios already appear in v3; relocating 4K results does not expand coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments: GRPO and DAPO appear in the 2K and 8K tables, while the 4K and Qwen2.5 comparisons additionally retain REINFORCE++ and REINFORCE++-Baseline.

E3.justification: The model configurations, context settings, Mean@32 evaluation, supplementary Pass@32 reporting, and 400-step Last/Best protocol are retained. Appendix H reports the same optimizer, budgets, batch sizes, rollout sampling, and clipping settings.

E4.justification: Appendix I.2 retains the same comparisons of clipping ratios, KL coefficients, and iterative versus fixed reference policies. Figures 8 and 9 contain unchanged ablation curves; their relocation and regrouping add no analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports training-seed counts, repeated-training uncertainty, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The existing averaging over 32 sampled responses and point-estimate reporting remain unchanged.

E6.justification: All five matched numerical result tables and all experimental plot panels are unchanged. For example, RPG-REINFORCE-URKL's 8K AIME25 Best score remains 0.5208 in v3 Table 4 and v4 Table 3. v3's 4K Table 3 becomes v4 Table 5 with identical entries.

T1.justification: The KL definitions, propositions, natural-policy-gradient derivation, and appendix proofs are unchanged. The added Eq. (4.1) could be explanatory shorthand, but C's differentiation behavior is unspecified. Its equivalence to the previously documented detached-weight construction therefore cannot be established reliably.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: unified KL gradients, surrogate equivalence, corrected GRPO weighting, clipping, and iterative reference updates. The claims of up to six percentage points over DAPO and 52% versus 47% on AIME25 are unchanged.

C2.justification: The interpretations linking stability, entropy, response length, and reference updates to performance are retained. The clipping bias–variance limitation and suggestion to develop principled clipping schedules also remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The implementation frameworks, cached reference probabilities, hardware, hyperparameters, and project access information are retained. Algorithms 1 and 2 are relocated or reformatted without changed pseudocode operations; the added clipping explanation does not establish newly disclosed implementation settings.

R1.justification: Appendix A retains the same related-work discussion and research positioning. The cited works are unchanged; differences in accents and a reference access date are bibliographic presentation edits.

P1.justification: v3 Section 4.1 moves to v4 Section 3.3, and a focused REINFORCE clipping explanation occupies the new Section 4.1. Section 5 emphasizes 8K results, while existing 2K/4K discussion moves to Appendix I.1. Most prose remains unchanged.

P2.justification: The document adopts ICLR typography, headers, captions, and substantially different float arrangements. v3's appendix Figure 5 becomes main-text Figure 2; its 4K Figure 3 and Table 3 move to Appendix I as Figure 5 and Table 5. Existing appendix displays are resized and regrouped throughout.

improvement.justification: Separating the clipping discussions and reorganizing existing results improves navigation while retaining all experimental evidence and proofs. However, new Eq. (4.1) leaves coefficient detachment unclear relative to unchanged Algorithm 2, creating ambiguity in a paper centered on correct gradients. Whether this is harmless shorthand or a substantive loss-description error is unresolved, preventing a reliable net quality judgment.
